title: Per-layout accepts schema
description: Meta-schema for spec/schema/layouts/<id>.json. Each layout ships one such file: an LLM-facing description plus formal role cardinalities, accepted unit types and per-role character ranges. match.mjs validates a unit-to-layout binding against it before scoring.
$comment: Shape copied from Presenton, the only public system with formal per-layout JSON Schema constraints (research/06 §c). Role names come from spec/vocab/element_role.json (research/06 §a); unit types from spec/vocab/unit_type.json (research/06 §b).

$id.description: The layout id this accepts file belongs to.

description.description: One-liner written for the planner LLM: what this layout is for and when to pick it.

requires.description: Roles that must be filled, with their cardinality. A binding missing any of these is invalid.

propertyNames.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/element_role.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it. Group concepts (broader "") are not valid role keys.

optional.description: Roles that may be filled. Unfilled optional roles are removed from the Canva page with delete_element.

propertyNames.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/element_role.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it. Group concepts (broader "") are not valid role keys.

accepts_unit_types.description: Content unit types this layout can carry.
accepts_unit_types.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/unit_type.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.

items.description: Cardinality of the repeated role, mirroring the layout min_items and max_items. Presenton minItems/maxItems.

chars.description: Character range per role. max must equal the maxChars of that role in the layout element table.

propertyNames.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/element_role.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it. Group concepts (broader "") are not valid role keys.

examples.description: KPI grid: four to six metric tiles, each a number with a short label. Use for a block of statistics that share a period or a theme.
examples.$comment: Tile count 4-6 from research/03 §(c) level 4 (dashboard 4-6 tiles) and research/02 #23 (2x2, 2x3, 3x2). title max 40 and number max 6 and label max 20 from research/02 §Grid and type conventions (Mck character budgets); title min 8 from Presenton title-and-bullets (research/06 §c).

examples.description: Two-column comparison: one action title over two parallel columns. Use for option A against option B, cause against effect, or problem against solution.
examples.$comment: Roles and accepted unit types from research/06 §(c) two_column (requires title x1 and column x2; accepts comparison, cause_effect, problem+solution, concession). column max 200 = at most 4 bullets (research/03 §(c) level 3, Kosslyn rule of four) x at most 50 characters per bullet (research/02 §Grid and type conventions).
